title: Installation of Elderly-friendly Facilities in Schools to Cater to Ageing Teaching Workforce and Those with Mobility Issues
what_it_is: Installation of Elderly-friendly Facilities in Schools to Cater to Ageing Teaching Workforce and Those with Mobility Issues

sections.label: School lift upgrading programme
sections.summary: About 70% of Government primary and secondary schools have lifts, with the rest to get them over five years, considering demographics, student profile and teaching needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: About 70% of our Government primary and secondary schools are currently fitted with lifts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The remaining schools would be provided with lifts over the next five years, either as part of their scheduled major upgrading works, or else, as a special lift upgrading programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Is there any consultation or review with the teachers in the school before it has been planned to be built?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We also look at the demographics, the student profile and the teaching needs availability and requirement of the people who work within the school as well as those who use the facilities.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will continue to do this to ensure that it provides as much as possible barrier-free accessibility to all the stakeholders.

sections.label: Consultation with teaching community
sections.summary: The Member's case is specific and further details will be sought, while noting schools are consulted and some may have higher-priority issues.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I think this is a very specific case.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I will get further details from the Member.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Nevertheless, as I mentioned earlier, this is something that we always look out for.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We speak to the teaching community in the school and, at the same time, there may be issues of greater priority that we want to tackle in certain schools, which I may be able to share with the Member later.
